owner_names: BHAV Partners II LLC; Giri Devanur
footnote_text: Reflects the 5,098 Class A ordinary shares of the registrant that are included in the 5,098 private placement units of the registrant purchased by BHAV Partners II LLC (the "Sponsor") on November 12, 2026 in connection with the underwriters' partial exercise of their over-allotment option. Each private placement unit was purchased for $10.00 per unit and consists of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth (1/4) of one Class A ordinary share upon consummation of the registrant's initial business combination. || The reporting owner, the Sponsor, in whose name the securities reported herein are held, is managed by its managing member, Giri Devanur. Mr. Devanur is also the Chief Executive Officer and director of the registrant. Mr. Devanur holds voting and investment discretion with respect to the securities held of record by the Sponsor. Mr. Devanur may be deemed a beneficial owner of securities held by the Sponsor but he disclaims beneficial ownership of any such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
